newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil futures end near high, Brent firmer.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil futures end near high, Brent firmer.

text.p: IPE gas oil ended close to the session high on on Wednesday, buoyed by the resiliance of NYMEX product futures in the face of bearish stocks data.
"It's really on sentiment," said one broker. "There's no need for the market to ease back as all products are well bid."
Dec gas oil closed up $1.25 a tonne at $224, having rebounded off an intra-day low of $221.50.

Data released earlier by the Energy Information Administration showed an increase in U.S. distillate stocks of 3.9 million barrels, while American Petroleum Institute data estimated a distillate build of 1.8 million barrels.
Jan Brent also made strong gains after retracing losses in line with NYMEX crude which shrugged off EIA data showing a 200,000 barrel build in U.S. crude stocks.
Brent was trading 14 cents higher at $23.91 a barrel, off a session high of $23.96, having breached resistance at $23.80.
The next key resistance was pegged at $24.
"Brent is looking better and better," said one dealer. "We're waiting for it to go through $24."
